user.title: Add a lamp
user.description: Pick the light or switch that powers the lamp. Times and looks can be changed later with Configure.

data_description.warm_pct: Brightness during warm-up. Ignored for lamps that can't dim.
data_description.maintain_pct: Brightness after warm-up. Ignored for lamps that can't dim.
data_description.floor_pct: Brightness is tapered linearly from maintain to this value, reaching it at max runtime. Ignored for lamps that can't dim.
data_description.warmup_min: Turning the lamp off before this time has passed simply resets, with no cooldown.
data_description.max_run_min: Lamp is switched off here and cooldown begins. Check the lamp manual.
data_description.cooldown_min: Turn-ons are blocked (lamp switched back off) for this long.
data_description.wax_color: Used by the Flow Lamp dashboard card. The wax is seen through the liquid, so its color is mixed with the liquid's.
data_description.liquid_color: Used by the Flow Lamp dashboard card.
data_description.liquid_clear: Turn on for clear liquid. The liquid color is then ignored.
data_description.dimming: Lamps that can't dim (switches, on/off-only lights) skip the brightness taper and have no Dimming level sensor.

error.floor_above_maintain: Lowest brightness can't be above maintain brightness.
error.runtime_too_short: Warm-up + hold can't be longer than the maximum runtime.
